Specification: This module contains TLAPS proofs for a TCP finite-state-machine specification imported from the module tcp, but it only extracts and proves facts stated explicitly in this proof module. It proves safety properties of the imported spec, in particular type correctness (Spec => []TypeOK) and an agreement invariant Inv stating that when both peer-to-peer message queues are empty, the two peers agree on whether they are in the ESTABLISHED state. To carry out the safety proof, it introduces a stronger inductive invariant IndInv with several auxiliary clauses about singleton messages, evidence for ESTABLISHED, and the last message in a queue, and it reasons under the intended two-peer model using choice functions A and B together with finiteness/cardinality assumptions about Peers.
AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), s # << >>
  PROVE  Tail(s) \in Seq(T)

ASSUME NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(T), NEW e \in T
  PROVE  Append(s, e) \in Seq(T)

ASSUME NEW T, NEW e \in T, NEW s \in Seq(T), IsPrefix(<<e>>, s)
  PROVE  /\ s # << >>
         /\ Head(s) = e
         /\ Tail(s) \in Seq(T)

ASSUME NEW T, NEW e1 \in T, NEW e2 \in T, NEW s \in Seq(T),
         IsPrefix(<<e1, e2>>, s)
  PROVE  /\ Len(s) >= 2
         /\ s[1] = e1
         /\ s[2] = e2
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, [Next]_vars  PROVE TypeOK'

ASSUME NEW local \in Peers, NEW remote \in Peers,
                PASSIVE_OPEN(local, remote) \/ ACTIVE_OPEN(local, remote)
                  \/ CLOSE_SYN_SENT(local, remote)
                  \/ CLOSE_SYN_RECEIVED(local, remote)
                  \/ CLOSE_LISTEN(local, remote)
                  \/ CLOSE_ESTABLISHED(local, remote)
                  \/ CLOSE_CLOSE_WAIT(local, remote)
                  \/ SEND(local, remote)
         PROVE  TypeOK'

ASSUME NEW local \in Peers, NEW remote \in Peers,
                  \/ SynSent(local, remote)
                  \/ SynReceived(local, remote)
                  \/ Listen(local, remote)
                  \/ Established(local, remote)
                  \/ FinWait1(local, remote)
                  \/ FinWait2(local, remote)
                  \/ Closing(local, remote)
                  \/ LastAck(local, remote)
                  \/ TimeWait(local, remote)
                  \/ Note2(local, remote)
          PROVE  TypeOK'
SUFFICES ASSUME Peers = {} PROVE FALSE
SUFFICES ASSUME \A y \in Peers : y = A PROVE FALSE
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW z \in Peers, z # A, z # B PROVE FALSE
SUFFICES ASSUME Init  PROVE Inv
SUFFICES ASSUME Init  PROVE IndInv
SUFFICES ASSUME IndInv, UNCHANGED vars PROVE IndInv'

ASSUME IndInv, TypeOK',
         NEW local \in Peers, NEW remote \in Peers,
         \/ PASSIVE_OPEN(local, remote)
         \/ ACTIVE_OPEN(local, remote)
         \/ CLOSE_SYN_SENT(local, remote)
         \/ CLOSE_SYN_RECEIVED(local, remote)
         \/ CLOSE_LISTEN(local, remote)
         \/ CLOSE_ESTABLISHED(local, remote)
         \/ CLOSE_CLOSE_WAIT(local, remote)
         \/ SEND(local, remote)
  PROVE  IndInv'

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in Peers, NEW q \in Peers,
                            p # q,
                            network'[p] = <<"RST">>,
                            network'[q] = <<>>
                     PROVE  connstate'[q] # "ESTABLISHED"

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in Peers, NEW q \in Peers,
                            p # q,
                            network'[p] = <<"ACK">>,
                            network'[q] = <<>>,
                            connstate'[p] = "SYN-RECEIVED"
                     PROVE  connstate'[q] = "ESTABLISHED"

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in Peers, NEW q \in Peers,
                            p # q,
                            network'[p] = <<"ACKofFIN">>,
                            network'[q] = <<>>,
                            connstate'[p] \in {"FIN-WAIT-1", "CLOSING", "LAST-ACK"}
                     PROVE  connstate'[q] # "ESTABLISHED"

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in Peers, NEW q \in Peers,
                            p # q,
                            connstate'[p] = "ESTABLISHED"
                     PROVE  \/ connstate'[q] \in PostEst
                            \/ HasMsg("SYN", p)'        \/ HasMsg("SYN", q)'
                            \/ HasMsg("ACK", q)'        \/ HasMsg("ACK", p)'
                            \/ HasMsg("SYN,ACK", q)'    \/ HasMsg("SYN,ACK", p)'
                            \/ HasMsg("FIN", p)'        \/ HasMsg("FIN", q)'
                            \/ HasMsg("ACKofFIN", p)'   \/ HasMsg("ACKofFIN", q)'
                            \/ HasMsg("RST", p)'        \/ HasMsg("RST", q)'

SUFFICES ASSUME network[p] = <<>>, network[q] = <<>>
                        PROVE  FALSE

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in Msgs, NEW r \in Peers, HasMsg(m, r)
                       PROVE  HasMsg(m, r)'

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in Peers, NEW q \in Peers,
                            p # q, network'[p] # <<>>
                     PROVE  /\ connstate'[q] = "SYN-RECEIVED"  => LastMsg(p)' = "SYN,ACK"
                            /\ connstate'[q] = "FIN-WAIT-1"    => LastMsg(p)' \in {"FIN", "RST"}
                            /\ connstate'[q] = "CLOSE-WAIT"    => LastMsg(p)' = "ACKofFIN"
                            /\ connstate'[q] = "LAST-ACK"      => LastMsg(p)' = "FIN"
                            /\ connstate'[q] = "CLOSING"       => LastMsg(p)' = "ACKofFIN"
                            /\ connstate'[q] = "SYN-SENT"      => LastMsg(p)' = "SYN"

ASSUME IndInv, TypeOK',
         NEW local \in Peers, NEW remote \in Peers,
         \/ SynSent(local, remote)
         \/ SynReceived(local, remote)
         \/ Listen(local, remote)
         \/ Established(local, remote)
         \/ FinWait1(local, remote)
         \/ FinWait2(local, remote)
         \/ Closing(local, remote)
         \/ LastAck(local, remote)
         \/ TimeWait(local, remote)
         \/ Note2(local, remote)
  PROVE  IndInv'

ASSUME IndInv, TypeOK',
         NEW local \in Peers, NEW remote \in Peers,
         Note3(local, remote)
  PROVE  IndInv'
SUFFICES ASSUME IndInv, [Next]_vars PROVE IndInv'
